title: fix: simply from and to in message to string type
body:
## :bookmark_tabs: Summary

Change the type of from and to to string

### Before
```
from?: { actor: string };
to?: { actor: string };
  ```
  
  ### Now
  ```
  from?:  string;
  to?:string;
  ```

comments.author: sidharthv96
comments.body:
Why is a `.actor` being added here, while it's removed everywhere else?

It also deviates from the uniform way where `param.actor` is the first parameter in other functions. 
 
Maybe we should modify the addSignal function to accept the right type data?

comments.author: ad1992
comments.body:
The reason is in this case the input is 
```
{ actor: { actor: 'John' } }
```

Hence for these two cases `activeStart` and `activeEnd` I am passing `param.actor.actor` as `addSignal` except s a string param and not object anymore.

comments.author: sidharthv96
comments.body:
Was it not working previously then?
Where is the input coming from? Can we fix it there?

comments.author: ad1992
comments.body:
yes, it was working previously since the actor was an object. I tried looking deeper into this earlier to fix it the caller instead but wasn't sure where exactly I should be fixing it.
The syntax of activation / deactivation leads to the actor being created as an object

```
Alice->>+John: Yes
John-->>-Alice: OK
```

Could you point me to the right direction of where I can fix the above to generate actor as a string instead of object ?
